canonicalArchitecture: Warm air. Wet wool. A corridor the colour of dried wine. A notice points left to the working toilets. The bar is ahead; a cloakroom opens on the right.

staticArchitecture.text: Dried-wine corridor; bar ahead, cloakroom right, toilets left
